newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 27.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on May 27:

ZURICH - Swiss pharmaceuticals group Roche Holding AG ROCZg.Z said it has agreed to buy German diagnostics and pharmaceuticals company, Boehringer Manheim Group and a leading U.S. orthopedics products company DePuy Inc., in a deal worth $11 billion.
NEW YORK - Netscape Communications Corp. and other high technology companies plan to propose a global standard for protecting the privacy of World Wide Web users.

WASHINGTON - When the Federal Reserve raised short-term interest rates in March, at a time that there was no sign inflation was about to get worse, Fed officials justified the move on grounds that they needed to be "forward looking" to keep inflation under control in the future.
WASHINGTON - The meat of the Australian emu is making inroads as a specialty food, while its oil has therapeutic potential.
